description: This file defines the AttachmentStream class for streaming attachment files, including downloading, decrypting, and handling progress and abort signals within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: AttachmentStream
classes.description: A stream class for handling attachment files, including downloading, decrypting, and enqueuing files for processing.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AttachmentStream with attachment IDs, resolve function, optional abort signal, and progress callback. Sets up abort handling and stream start logic.
